P01.note: Sealed valley with no outlet makes 'trapped'; 'no low saddle' kills sidetracked and 'rising behind it' kills swallowed.

P02.note: Paid feature videos = publicist; direct dealing, no part in disputes, and decades-old approach each kill one distractor.

P03.note: Total reliance and collapse after closure = crutch; notices-only/no side/throughout kill engine, compass, epilogue.

P04.note: Recreation in the dead teacher's manner signed with both names = homage; changed nothing, own manner, never sold kill the rest.

P05.note: Accurate but uncited and uninfluential = sideshows; accurate, no part, never calibrated against each kill one option.

P06.note: Permanent rights with no yielding and quarrels inherited for generations = entrenched; never more bitter, at once, same courts kill others.

P07.note: Bankers who refused her loans dwarfed by the wealth they prized = ironic; sketches, 1960 start, most of background kill the rest.

P08.note: Flood drowned the predator ants so the colony thrived = sheltered; water never reached / spit above kill swamped and stranded, starved only implicitly.

P09.note: Growth slowed and never recovered, half height = stunted; suffered as badly, almost all survived, oaks unchanged kill the rest.

P10.note: Fixing flaws with a few lines of code = patched; kept running, old name, instead of buying kill the rest.

P11.note: Kept every scene but shuffled order = jumbled; adding nothing, every scene, grave sincerity kill the rest.

P12.note: Single number, confidential formula = opaque; just covered cost, larger homes paid more, next month's pickup kill the rest.

P13.note: Recovery retracing decline in reverse = symmetric; no pause and fell by half kill stepwise/shallow, but a dip that fully recovered is arguably transient.

P14.note: Loss concentrated in three summers = sporadic; plainly visible, great deal, never regained kill the rest.

P15.note: Admission charges and pennant sales = commercialized; 'just as court papers did' and rowdier kill embellished/defused, but a school taking over an informal game could read as formalized.

P16.note: Group met only in the room above the shop = housed; grew quickly, unchanged lines, already writing kill the rest.

P17.note: Each shop fired twice as many pieces = doubled; kept making, every quarter, cheap so no longer gifts kill the rest.

P18.note: Factions fought and brawled over stalls = battleground; shouting down speakers kills forum, same goods undercuts clearinghouse, archive only implicit.

P19.note: Stopped halfway and wintered there = truncated; left together, no larger, usual week kill the rest.

P20.note: Obeyed 'as our grandfathers did' = customary; no guards or fines kills coercive, five eldest decided every question kills diffuse, ancillary only implicit.

P21.note: Paragraph after nearly every stanza = interrupted; exactly as written, no pictures, order found kill the rest.

P22.note: A week of flour and coal at a tenth the cost = frugal; short form and ignoring popular methods kill cumbersome/fashionable, but designing alone against prevailing methods could read as experimental.

P23.note: Separate swappable parts = modular; one fault crashed all, freely shared, most advanced kill the rest.

P24.note: Crusts build soil where mosses and ferns take root = scaffold; shrug off pollution, spread after walls built, no steady rate kill the rest.

P25.note: Private coaching of the chair = mentor; chair did bargaining, committee already formed, stayed away kill the rest.

P26.note: Same twelve routes on different streets = redrawn; ran itself, all twelve kept, savings from fuel kill the rest.

P27.note: More than most families could pay = prohibitive; paid once, nothing returned, matched to the cent kill the rest.

P28.note: Cited later as proof such laws survive court = precedent; courts upheld kills overreach, rarely mattered kills remedy, pledge only implicit.

P29.note: Promise reread whenever she thought of quitting = lifeline; gave it away kills keepsake, advice wrong kills lodestar, grievance only implicit.

P30.note: Pause covering a scene change, characters return to same spots = interlude; stand where they stood kills hinge, loved kills letdown, kernel implicit.

P31.note: Unheated rooms, pawned dresses, bus stations = gritty; whole chapters, unsparing, revised a decade kill the rest.

P32.note: 300 clauses covering even rare cases = exhaustive; never named seizures, refused quick truce, enforced a century kill the rest.
